title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to docs and examples. These are backwards-compatible docs/examples only.
description: Motivation: Provide first-class RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and simple tool-calling quickstarts to accelerate developer onboarding and reduce repeated pattern drift. This PR adds reusable agent templates, two guided quickstarts (RAG and tool-calling), updated docs site TOC, example notebooks, and images explaining the workflow. Changes are docs/examples only and do not modify runtime code. What I changed: added templates under redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates, added two quickstarts under redwood-examples/quickstarts (rag-quickstart, tool-calling-quickstart), updated docs site pages and sidebar to surface quickstarts, added small example notebooks and a workflow diagram. Tests and CI: docs build pipeline updated to run example notebooks; added smoke checks for quickstart snippets. Checklist: [x] Add RAG agent templates [x] Add tool-calling quickstart [x] Update docs site TOC and cross-links [x] Add notebooks and images [x] Run docs CI and verify build Notes: examples reference the public demo dataset and use the Redwood SDK v0.34-compatible APIs. See linked Linear tasks for sample prompts and evals.
commits_summary: 3 commits initial templates and quickstarts, docs site and TOC updates, CI tweaks and fixups
